question: A woman who has had two previous deliveries (one preterm live birth and one term live birth) and is currently pregnant is correctly described using the obstetric formula G3P2+0 (gravida 3, para 2, no abortions).

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Gravida counts ALL pregnancies including the present one (G3). Para counts all deliveries after 20 weeks regardless of outcome (2 deliveries = P2). Abortions/miscarriages are the '+' suffix; here it is 0. So G3P2+0 is correct.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Gravida (G) counts every pregnancy including the current one — so current pregnancy makes her G3. Para (P) counts deliveries after 20 weeks (both preterm and term count), giving P2. With no abortions the formula is G3P2+0.
